name: LTTH overlay raw-path guard
description: Environment-isolated caller-marker removal and safe raw-path attestation for the overlay Workers.

rules.description: Remove every caller-supplied production LTTH raw-path marker.
rules.expression: http.host eq "overlay.ltth.app" or (starts_with(http.host, "r-") and ends_with(http.host, ".ltth.app") and len(http.host) eq 43)

rules.description: Restore the production marker only when immutable raw path structure is safe.
rules.expression: (http.host eq "overlay.ltth.app" or (starts_with(http.host, "r-") and ends_with(http.host, ".ltth.app") and len(http.host) eq 43)) and not (raw.http.request.uri.path contains "\\") and not (raw.http.request.uri.path contains "//") and not (raw.http.request.uri.path eq "/.") and not (raw.http.request.uri.path eq "/..") and not (raw.http.request.uri.path contains "/./") and not (raw.http.request.uri.path contains "/../") and not ends_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/.") and not ends_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/..") and not (lower(raw.http.request.uri.path) contains "%2f") and not (lower(raw.http.request.uri.path) contains "%5c") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") contains "\\") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") contains "//") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") eq "/.") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") eq "/..") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") contains "/./") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") contains "/../") and not ends_with(url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r"), "/.") and not ends_with(url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r"), "/..") and not (lower(url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r")) contains "%2f") and not (lower(url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r")) contains "%5c")

rules.description: Remove every caller-supplied staging LTTH raw-path marker.
rules.expression: http.host eq "overlay-staging.ltth.app" or (starts_with(http.host, "r-") and ends_with(http.host, ".overlay-staging.ltth.app") and len(http.host) eq 59)

rules.description: Restore the staging marker only when immutable raw path structure is safe.
rules.expression: (http.host eq "overlay-staging.ltth.app" or (starts_with(http.host, "r-") and ends_with(http.host, ".overlay-staging.ltth.app") and len(http.host) eq 59)) and not (raw.http.request.uri.path contains "\\") and not (raw.http.request.uri.path contains "//") and not (raw.http.request.uri.path eq "/.") and not (raw.http.request.uri.path eq "/..") and not (raw.http.request.uri.path contains "/./") and not (raw.http.request.uri.path contains "/../") and not ends_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/.") and not ends_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/..") and not (lower(raw.http.request.uri.path) contains "%2f") and not (lower(raw.http.request.uri.path) contains "%5c") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") contains "\\") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") contains "//") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") eq "/.") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") eq "/..") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") contains "/./") and not (url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r") contains "/../") and not ends_with(url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r"), "/.") and not ends_with(url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r"), "/..") and not (lower(url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r")) contains "%2f") and not (lower(url_decode(raw.http.request.uri.path, "r")) contains "%5c")
